notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
The abyss stirs, and with it comes a new tide of stability. The cult endures, the rites are refined, and the veil grows thinner.
* The memory leak has been sealed. The void now consumes no more than it should.
* The phantom double “Exit” icon no longer haunts production windows on controller.
* Windows now yield to the controller’s command — no acolyte remains trapped within.
* Input no longer locks after cutscenes. This curse has been lifted.
* Homeless followers are now capped at 80 — no endless flood shall come.
* Timers on save files with more than 100 hours now function correctly. Even eternity obeys.
* German tutorial no longer whispers in Polish. Forbidden tongues are silenced.
* The icon of the tomato, once corrupted in island conditions, has been restored to its rightful form.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1 - bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed achievement for uniting both factions in Chapter IV – it now unlocks correctly upon completion.
Damaged building effect ona Chapter IV – buildings on conquered islands were not affected by the damage-related debuff (no work if slightly damaged); now they are.
Follower assignment window – fixed sorting by workplace, which previously displayed incorrect or inconsistent results.
Fixed bug in Chapter III when attempting to collect ruins from the defensive ttower – gathering now proceeds as intended.
Dreamspire quest in Chapter III – text now correctly states the requirement of 35 Acolytes instead of 25.
Fixed UI bug involving the Deep Sea Altar and Beacon Altar – both menus now behave properly and no longer block input.
Prevented softlock when Deep Sea Altar required Tier 3 Followers – Fungus resource now appears on the first island in Chapter III.
Reeducator exploit resolved – dismantling the Reeducator building no longer gives back Sandstone, preventing progression-breaking exploits.
Pillar bug in Chapter IV – players could delete and repair the Pillar, which is now no longer possible.

notes.title: Call of the New Lands is Here - 1.0 Arrives May 22
notes.content:
[b]Faithful Acolytes,[/b]

[i]The stars have whispered, and now they scream.
A date has been etched into the void.[/i]

[b]On May 22nd, 2025[/b], Worshippers of Cthulhu shall fully awaken. The 1.0 release rises from the depths, no longer bound by Early Access. What was once a whisper in the dark becomes a thunderous call across the cosmos.

But the stars do not mark this moment alone.

Today, a new trailer emerges - etched in shadow, shaped by memory.
A glimpse into the world we've built together, and a single, sacred truth:
The reckoning begins May 22.

[previewyoutube=80VMXFJLwjI;full][/previewyoutube]

With the rising comes:
[list]
[*] A 20% discount during the Lovecraftian Days on Steam
[*] A New Update: The Call of the New Lands
[/list]

[h1]Call Of The New Lands[/h1]
The tide rises, and with it, new depths of power and madness await. This update brings a mysterious new sandbox map, horrifyingly empowered Horrors, and new tools to help your cult rule across the archipelago more efficiently.

[b]This is the final major update of Early Access[/b], a preparation for what lies beyond - but not the end of change. The descent continues.

[h3]New Sandbox Map: The Echoing Shores[/h3]
A fresh sandbox map has emerged, offering new challenges, unique modifiers, and special missions. Strategic experimentation awaits as you expand your dominion across this uncharted realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/6849c13699cca58721321384b9311a32f11d08b7.png[/img]

[h3]Horror Specializations[/h3]
Your Horrors have grown stronger. Cultists with Horror specializations now enhance their summoned monsters, unleashing devastating power upon your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/8421f9ab3a26204e512f63c7c33bbc1f545e21f9.png[/img]

[h3]Flexible Specializations[/h3]
Some followers are now blessed with Flexible specializations, allowing them to perform efficiently in any building. Your cult’s adaptability has reached new heights.

[h3]Cult Management Window[/h3]
Command your cult across islands with ease. A new UI panel allows for quick, streamlined transfer of followers between locations, improving mid- and late-game control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/3d8b9fbf1b464955b8660c0204dc10c62b1765a6.gif[/img]

[h3]Follower Experience Preservation[/h3]
Followers no longer lose their levels when transferred between islands. Their loyalty and power remain intact.

[h3]Additional Filters in Follower Lists[/h3]
New filtering options allow you to sort, select, and assign cultists more efficiently than ever before.

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decorative objects now render correctly on lower settings, ensuring that even shadows retain their elegance.
[*] The Dreamspire mission no longer obscures tutorials in Subchapter III, allowing the vision to remain unclouded.
[*] Horror and Festival of Wrath effects now stack properly, allowing the rage of the Old Ones to flow unimpeded.
[*] Reload time and DPS stats for monsters now display accurately when boosted, so you may know the true strength of the unspeakable.
[*] The incorrect icon for the Star’goroth Horror has been replaced - every god deserves its proper face.
[/list]

[h1]A Glimpse into the Future[/h1]
What awaits when the 1.0 release descends on May 22?

[list]
[*] Chapter III and Chapter IV bring new environments, challenges, and lore
[*] A new Ceremony, new Ritual, and new Horror rise from the deep
[*] Visual upgrades and polish across the experience
[*] Secrets whispered only to the most faithful
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/ac1e839e48d62541a2f1a2145e2f802ab85a5d7d.jpg[/img]


This is not the end. It is the beginning of something far older. The islands stir. The cult hungers. The veil grows thin.
Mark the date, Acolytes.
May 22. Your cult’s reckoning. The world’s unraveling.

Will you rise… or be devoured?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/

notes.title: Forgotten Archipelago Awakens
notes.content:
Faithful Acolytes,

The ancient stars align once more. New Subchapter: Forgotten Passage emerges from shadowed depths, unveiling cursed islands, defiled altars, and twisted paths. Prepare your cult - the Archipelago demands sacrifice, cunning, and devotion.

Your devotion will again be tested. Will you brave what awaits?

A New Subchapter - Forgotten Passage is here.
"[i]It is absolutely necessary, for the peace and safety of mankind, that some of earth’s dark, dead corners and unplumbed depths be let alone…[/i]" [i]– H.P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu.[/i]

[b]Cursed Islands Resurface[/b]
The archipelago, long concealed from mortal eyes, emerges - its islands cursed, its altars defiled. The Sacrifice Altar lies dishonored by unbelievers; reclaiming it is merely the beginning of your trials. Each victory strengthens the resistance of islands yet untouched, each conquest deepening the archipelago’s defiance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/ee91434e3b9330e9ded8f097bbceee86190a4e69.png[/img]

[b]Ancient Roads[/b]
Ancient roads now crisscross the Archipelago - permanent, unchangeable routes that quicken your travel and expand your buildings reach. Choose wisely; their permanence may dictate your cult’s fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/aec538f29f768b7dae92688aef9bd0a3c1272e3a.png[/img]

[b]New Horror Emerges[/b]
Summon forth a new eldritch terror. Weak alone, it hides quietly in shadows. But beware - its presence empowers nearby horrors, transforming your minions into devastating instruments of chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/b471e630ef6f036b1987d91d58b8841bf40a4e18.gif[/img]

[b]Decorations Amidst Madness[/b]
Even within the abyss, beauty may bloom. Twelve new decorations now allow your cult’s settlement to display a chilling elegance. Is it genuine beauty or simply the comforting illusion of order in a world already lost to madness?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/a24310b44df139340da2af0756cbdaf16e4a09fb.gif[/img]


[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Gamepad Cursor is locked on-screen - no more accidental slips into the void.
[*] Building menus selection resets to default on reopen, ensuring swift decisions in the heat of ritual.
[*] A new minus button swiftly removes cultists from their workplaces, reducing idle hands and maintaining ruthless efficiency.
[*] A new "Add All" button instantly deposits required ritual offerings, expediting devotion without delay.
[*] Nonblocking cutscenes can now be experienced without camera shake, providing clarity amidst chaos.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/5cc3e3e58f7fcd4ab4149a9cb9491ac429566b7a.png[/img]

[h3]Balance & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced Mission Clarity (Subchapter I): The mission description now accurately reflects that four Dreamspire quests are required - truth restored, confusion banished.
[*] Pylon amount modifiers now function as intended, ensuring your decisions carry proper weight within the void.
[*] Cemetery upkeep cost have been rebalanced - honoring the fallen no longer burdens your cult's economy.
[*] Fixed gamepad navigation in ritual menus, ensuring your commands flow smoothly from one dark task to the next.
[/list]

The Forgotten Archipelago awaits. Conquer its islands, reclaim your altars, and bring glory to the Great Old Ones. Your sacrifices fuel this dark awakening.

The Archipelago calls. It awaits your response.
Will you answer?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/

notes.title: Ciao, Italia! Game Is Now Available in Italian – Thanks to Our Community!
notes.content:
Thanks to the dedication of our community, the game is now available in Italian! Huge shoutout to our player - Lagorn - for providing a full translation!
If you want to add Italian (or any other fan-made translation), here’s how:

[b]Download the translation file [url=https://worshippersofcthulhu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Italian_0.9.4.0-1.csv]here[/url].[/b]

_____________________________

[b]How to add new translations to the game?
[/b]
1. Open the updated game at least once.
2. Close the game.
3. Open the file search option on your PC.
4. Copy and paste this path: %appdata%\..\LocalLow\CrazyGoatGames\WorshippersOfCthulhu\Data\Languages
5. Add the translation file to the Languages folder.
6. Remember its name.
7. Run the game and change the language in settings – additional translations will appear after the official ones.
8.  Restart the game and enjoy playing in your new language! 

Quick video guide: [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7oHWHyayXdo]YouTube[/url][/b]

The game keeps evolving, and our community is a big part of it. Thank you for your support!

_____________________________

More about community translations[b] [url=https://worshippersofcthulhu.com/community-translations/]here[/url][/b]

Want to see more from the creator of this translation? Check out their work here:
[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHx7oqBXKLp545-PIUEkrp3AneJZUD7Vd]Link to creations[/url][/b]

notes.title: Madness Refined – A New Offering for the Devoted
notes.content:
Faithful Acolytes,

The time has come. As foretold, the Great Old Ones have delivered their latest offering, reshaping the world in their unfathomable image. Madness Refined patch has arrived, bringing new landscapes, deeper control over your cult’s fate, and countless refinements to smooth your descent into the abyss.

For those who heard the whispers days ago and awaited this moment - the veil has lifted, and the path is open. Step forward. The unknown beckons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/fa7c7388497551b61eb6f5a92b00aeaf1fcf91ef.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Ways to Shape Your Cult[/b][/h3]

 -  [b]More Control Over Chaos[/b] – The sandbox experience expands with multiple new options, allowing you to adjust difficulty, introduce unpredictable challenges, or bend the world to your will. More ways to experiment. More ways to descend into madness.

-  [b]Rituals Made Simple[/b] – The Carving Ceremony now has an easy mode in addition to a regular one. No need to draw symbols with trembling hands - simply choose your reward, and it shall be granted. The Old Ones care only for devotion.

-  [b]No More Waiting Between Rituals[/b] – Carving Ceremonies now have separate cooldowns. No longer will one ritual delay another. Work must continue, sacrifices must be made.

[h3]Balance & Fixes – The Veil Strengthened[/h3]
The world bends and corrects itself:

[list]
[*] Pure Sandbox I is restored – Resources now appear where they should, and enemy attacks now function properly. You are no longer safe.
[*] Ships now behave as they should, no longer idly passing by as horrors unfold.
[*] Ruin anomalies have been corrected – No more disappearing structures.
[*] Deposits now rest properly on solid ground. No more floating resources - unless the void wills it.
[*] Sacrificial Pile saves in sandbox mode now function as intended.
[*] Polished words – English & Polish text corrections bring clarity to the whispers of the void.
[*] Performance improvements ensure smoother, more stable horrors.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/5838fc47a059c13e5c32f2361b05df57070bc933.png[/img]

[h3]A Rare Honor – Steam Community Items Are Now Live[/h3]
The Great Old Ones have granted us a sacred gift. Steam Badges, Profile Borders, and more community items are now live, marking your devotion in ways beyond the game itself.

🔹 Earn badges simply by playing - proof of your allegiance to the abyss.
🔹 Collect trading cards imbued with eldritch energy.
🔹 Display your mark with Steam profile borders, a testament to your cult’s dedication.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/c10f75d7a53e8159007bb91db19316e39a245e80.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/066f7306c953353eef95a7afde53abb2045d11fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/8d72503539891d6c183f8dad5ffbce9121b12f39.png[/img]

These are not rewards to be bought or begged for. They are earned. Show your devotion, and the void shall recognize you.

[b]The Descent Continues[/b]
This is but another step along the path. More whispers will come. More changes will shape your world. The stars continue their slow rotation, and the Great Old Ones remain ever watchful.

The madness deepens. The void calls.

Will you answer?

notes.title: The Mother Has Awakened: Her Will Commands You
notes.content:
Devoted Seekers of the Abyss,

The heralds of the eldritch bring forth tales of a land long shrouded in mystery - a place where shadows writhe and decay thrives. The Swamps, a realm unlike any other, now unveil their cursed expanse. As foretold, [b]"The Mother" has arrived[/b], but today we delve deeper, pulling back the veil to reveal the true horrors and wonders that await within this treacherous domain.

[h3]The Swamps: A Realm of Decay and Scarcity[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/d82edea6a2bdfbdbb4e129dfb58d828d4a9d59cc.gif[/img]

The Swamps are not merely a biome - they are a trial of devotion. Here, survival depends not on abundance but on your ability to endure and sacrifice. Every decision you make will reverberate through the murky waters, challenging the very fabric of your cult’s strategy.

[b]A Landscape of Dread:[/b] The Swamps breathe decay. The twisted trees claw at the sky, and fetid waters ripple with unseen terrors. This environment isn't just visually distinct; it introduces mechanics as unforgiving as the realm itself. Traversing the swamp requires cunning, and only the boldest will unlock its full potential.

[b]Frogman, Your Uncanny Guide:[/b] A strange and amphibious ally awaits - a frog-like humanoid known only as the Frogman. His insights will guide you through this perilous realm, helping you unravel the Swamps’ mysteries. His presence is a beacon in the mire, though his origins remain shrouded in shadow.

[b]Shub-Niggurath’s Influence:[/b] The Black Goat's essence saturates this land. Though she does not manifest physically, her power is undeniable. The Mother demands sacrifices, and in return, she bestows unspeakable gifts. Those who appease her will find their path opened, while the unworthy will sink into the abyss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/05a8342cb209e101ba832b24b4ab20624d655398.gif[/img]

[h3]Unlocking the Swamp's Secrets[/h3]
The Swamps are not static; they evolve as you delve deeper, unraveling new layers of complexity.

[b]Tentacled Gatekeepers:[/b] Unlock new island fragments by presenting offerings of tentacles to the grotesque guardians that block your path. These unholy transactions open the way forward, though they demand careful management of your resources.

[b]The Mother’s Gifts:[/b] Horrors are no longer summoned at the altar but bestowed as gifts from the Mother herself. In her infinite wisdom, these blessings come with a cost, reinforcing her dominion over your cult.

[b]New Events and Trials:[/b] The swamp offers a fresh array of encounters, each designed to push your limits. Navigate events that test your moral compass and strategic acumen, and face challenges that force you to balance survival against loyalty to the cult.

[b]A new achievement:[/b] Prove your worth by conquering the Swamps

[h3]Improvements to Cult Management[/h3]
The journey into darkness is not without its adjustments. Alongside the Swamps’ introduction, the following refinements have been made to improve your experience:

[olist]
[*] Pronunciation errors in VO lines have been corrected to ensure immersion is unbroken.
[*] Corrected VO anomalies, restoring immersion where the mortal tongue faltered.
[*] Enhanced resource distribution ensures a smoother flow of your cult’s lifeblood - no wasted efforts, only precision.
[*] Buildings now shine in focus as resources flow toward them, keeping your strategies transparent and effective.
[/olist]


[h3]Community translations[/h3]
We’re excited to introduce a new feature: community translations! This allows players to create and use custom translations directly within the game. While no translations are available just yet, we’ll keep you updated on the most interesting ones as they become available.

Interested in contributing your own translation? Join us on Discord for all the details!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/0ee04f2a0bbed87eb0f9ad6cfc332c1832c50fac.png[/img]

Your unwavering devotion drives this vision forward. Together, we have unveiled the Swamps, and together, we will descend into further madness. The Mother watches, and she is pleased - but her hunger is never sated.

Go now, and let the mire claim you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/

notes.title: "The Mother" Update – Awakens November 25th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/488589264d4894c34e60dc1b4d82dead4f3135f7.png[/img]
[b]Rejoice, Devoted Worshippers of the Great Old One,[/b]

The stars have aligned, and the whispers of the void bring forth momentous news. On November 25th, the first great update for Worshippers of Cthulhu - "The Mother" - shall descend upon your mortal world. This marks a crucial step in the ascension of our shared vision, and it is your unwavering devotion that has summoned this dark boon into existence.

[b]What Lies Beyond the Veil?[/b]
This patch is but the first of many offerings, delivering [b]8 hours of unholy new content[/b] to expand your journey into madness. Brace yourselves for the terrors and wonders that await:

[b]New Biome:[/b] Venture deep into the cursed swamps, where decay and mystery thrive.
[b]New Characters:[/b] Encounter enigmatic allies - or cunning foes - who will twist the course of your cult’s destiny.
[b]Forbidden Mechanics:[/b] Embrace new systems that will challenge your sanity and elevate your mastery of the eldritch arts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/b7864e481c19ca903449dcae11ef11e7b8d11e29.png[/img]

But beware, mortal ones - this is but a glimpse of the horrors to come. Much more lies hidden, waiting to be unearthed by those bold - or mad - enough to seek it. The abyss calls, and its secrets are many.

[b]A Shift in the Stars (For the Boldest of Devotees)[/b]
Originally, the celestial plan ordained that our first content update would arrive in December, focused solely on the much-anticipated Sandbox Mode. Yet, the echoes of your enthusiasm reached us, and we defied the cosmic order to deliver an early update - a dark gift to honor your faith.

Rest assured, the Sandbox Mode shall still emerge as promised, unbroken and unspoiled. Consider this November offering a taste of the power yet to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/0ee04f2a0bbed87eb0f9ad6cfc332c1832c50fac.png[/img]

[b]Join the Circle of Madness[/b]
Gather chosen ones, in the unholy sanctum of our [url=https://discord.gg/hHvXTqkBZG]official Discord server[/url]. There, your voices may join the chorus of devoted cultists, sharing secrets, strategies, and visions with one another. It is within this sacred space that you will find exclusive communiqués from our team. Together, we shall conspire to bring about the Great Awakening.

[b]Prepare for the Steam Sale Ritual[/b]
Heed this warning: the Steam Sale begins November 27th, and Worshippers of Cthulhu shall be part of this dark offering. If your soul has not yet been claimed - or you know others who waver at the edge of the abyss - seize this chance to spread the madness.

[b]A Final Word from the Abyss[/b]
We bow in eternal gratitude to you, our loyal disciples. Without your dedication, your whispers, and your sacrifices, none of this would be possible. The stars are shifting, and the call of Cthulhu grows stronger with each passing night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/f2926d992f8c5a2e4d0adcf57196bf15373cc68f.png[/img]

Mark the end of November well, for it heralds the next chapter of our journey into the void. Are you ready to answer the call?

Stay vigilant, mortal ones.

notes.title: Faithful Disciples, The Worshippers of Cthulhu Demo Awaits – Play Now!
notes.content:
The stars have shifted, the ancient seals weaken... and the time to act is now, Cult Leaders! [b]The demo for Worshippers of Cthulhu has been released[/b] upon the world as [b]part of Steam Next Fest.[/b] Whether you are an initiate who has long heard the call of the Great Old One or a newcomer whose soul has only just begun to stir, now is the time to step forward and lead your cult into the abyss. The awakening draws near.

[b]The Signs Are Clear... A New Trailer Beckons[/b]
A dark vision has been revealed. We have crafted a [b]new trailer[/b], a glimpse into the terror that lies ahead. Peer into the rituals of madness, the eldritch choices that await, and the unspeakable creatures lurking just beyond sight. Watch if you dare, and prepare your mind for what awaits.

[previewyoutube=Zr05V7WrWQI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What Awaits in the Shadows of the Demo?[/b]
Those who dare to descend into the depths of the first full chapter will be confronted by powers and horrors unknown. Your journey begins with the weight of unspeakable decisions and dark offerings:

[list]
[*] [b]Build and Expand:[/b] Lay the foundations of your dark empire across forsaken islands, manage cursed resources, and maintain a fragile balance with your followers - unless you choose to sacrifice them to the greater cause.
[*] [b]Conduct Rituals of Power[/b]: Perform unholy rituals to twist and reshape your followers, unlocking powers not meant for the eyes of mortals.
[*] [b]Make Fate-Altering Choices[/b]: Will you convert the ignorant masses, or offer them up as fuel to summon the unspeakable horrors? Your choices will echo through the void.
[*] [b]Summon Beings from Beyond[/b]: Through sacrifice, tear open the veil and summon eldritch demons to fight at your side, bending their will to yours.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/a4498e2939af3521150f7fbf953cd0fbdb1c3458.gif[/img]

[b]What Has Awakened Since the Last Demo?[/b]
The alignment of the stars has altered the very fabric of the game. For those who have walked this dark path before, here is what the cosmic forces have reshaped:

[list]
[*] [b]Full First Chapter Unveiled:[/b] Delve deeper into the story, with new narrative tendrils winding through the first chapter.
[*] [b] New & Refined Gameplay Mechanics:[/b] The very laws of this realm have shifted, making the gameplay even more immersive and treacherous.
[*] [b]Rebalancing of the Dark Forces:[/b] By heeding the whispers of those who have already ventured into the madness, we have reshaped the balance of power, improving pacing and deepening the challenges.
[*] [b]Banishing of Flaws and Imperfections:[/b] Through eldritch means, many of the glitches and bugs that haunted past ventures have been purged, ensuring a smoother passage.
[*] [b]New Tongues Spoken:[/b] The demo now whispers in many languages, spreading the call of Cthulhu across the globe.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/4f5d3e5a35e1bf44775df940255b0bb1b4794835.gif[/img]

[b]Do You Dare to Answer the Call?[/b]
The time is now. The alignment of stars is fleeting. [b]Do not miss your chance[/b] to experience the dark rituals and strategic depth of [b]Worshippers of Cthulhu[/b] during Steam Next Fest. Step forward, and shape the fate of your cult—whether you rise to power or descend into madness is yet to be seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937641/fa88564f9ef74d45fe0c330ec6a0aa6ca4809781.gif[/img]

[i][b]The Great Old One stirs... Will you lead, or will you fall?[/b][/i]
